translations.en: I know it belongs to you now,
but could you check whether it's the key to the library?
Of course, I wouldn't ask you to work for free.
I'll pay you properly. What do you say?
You would return to the ruins of @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r house
and see whether this key opens the hidden door you found there.
It seems like a simple enough job.
Did you have @7rAnselm@0r appraise it?
...Oh, not yet, I see.
@7rAnselm@0r is in town too.
Please find him and have him appraise it.
I heard from @7rCarmine@0r.
You found @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r house, didn't you?
I went to see it myself,
but there's one door that simply won't open.
Judging by the layout, I think it's a library,
but I can't find the key that opens it.
It should be something round, like a coin...
If it's a library, there might be books inside
about the demon god sealed away there, wouldn't you think?
Our documents so far leave so much unanswered.
I'd like you to find it somehow...
One particular object comes to mind.
The more @7rBeatrix@0r describes its precise size,
the more certain you are that it must be the one.
This... where on earth did you get it?
@7rTanya@0r gave it to you...?
Where did that girl find something like this?!
Did somebody call me?
Oh, perfect timing.
Where did you get this coin?
Um, I... picked it up a little while ago,
when I went to @6rBahelmeja@0r.
Grandma collects coins,
so I thought it would make a nice present.
But she said it was magical and gave it back.
I thought it might make a good luck charm,
so I gave it to this adventurer as thanks for finding old money for me.
Was that... wrong?
No. You did very well, @7rTanya@0r.
Please take this to @7rAnselm@0r for an appraisal right away.
He should be able to tell us whether it's the key.
It seems the object @7rTanya@0r found
may hold an important key.
You should follow @7rBeatrix's@0r advice
and ask @7rAnselm@0r to appraise it.
What can I do for you?
When you hold out the coin,
@7rAnselm@0r peers at it with interest.
This is... a furniture key of a kind used in the distant past.
It's enchanted, too. Quite potent.
You'd like me to appraise it?
Hmm. There's an inscription in an ancient language.
It says, "God created words."
translations.note: Puzzle clue retained literally. Confirm this wording against the library solution in game.

translations.en: Some sort of code, perhaps?
At any rate, as well as being a key to unlock furniture,
it's a charm to keep one's possessions safe.
You've found quite a nice little thing.
It's an ancient charm bearing a wish that things won't go missing,
so I expect it has some effect.
You still do not know whether it opens @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r library,
but it is certainly a furniture key from long ago.
With its mysterious message and enchantment,
it seems very likely to be the key you need.
For now, you should report to @7rBeatrix@0r.
You received @3rFairy Gloves@0r.
Now, let's have a look at the @3rPsalm@0r you brought back!
Everyone, including @7rAnselm@0r and @7rBeatrix@0r, turns to look
as @7rCarmine@0r spreads the @3rLast Psalm@0r out on the table.
What lies deep within the box? The stone says it is hope.
Where is the final hope? Everyone says Watering.
In Watering, nuts abound.
Gather three nuts, then bake a sweet to offer up.
Which nuts should you choose? Cocosnoot,
translations.note: Cocosnoot is a Dutch nut-name clue and display place name; do not replace it with coconut here.

translations.en: Amandel, and Walnoot will do.
translations.note: Amandel and Walnoot are Dutch clue/place names; explanation follows in E1359-E1360.

translations.en: Once your sweet is baked, offer it to Laurier.
In exchange for your sweet, Laurier gives you hope.
The final hope shall be yours.
What is this @3rPsalm@0r? A song about offering up sweets?
Cocosnoot means coconut. Amandel means almond.

context: Beatrix questions Tanya about the coin; Anselm appraises it; the party reads the Last Psalm together.
decisions: Control tokens remain on their source rows and in their original sequence. Genuine sentence continuations retain row boundaries; other omitted subjects are restored from scene context. Unknown historical warrior gender stays neutral. Item names follow the shared glossary; established imported prose and provenance remain intact.
